StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Life_Is_Strange

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 319630 is the original release (store list name "Life is Strange - Episode 1"; schema "Life is Strange"), which matches RAWG's 2015 entry (slug "life-is-strange-episode-1-2"). The store list also has "Life is Strange Remastered" (app 1265920) with the same 60 achievements; RAWG's search did not return a separate Remastered entry in its top five, so the original app was used, as was done for Before the Storm. None of the 60 Steam achievements is hidden: 5 are episode completions and 55 are optional photos (ten per episode plus one "all photos" each). StrategyWiki has nothing under "Life is Strange" but has a stub under "Life Is Strange" (capital I, completion stage 0): only its Table of Contents (about 700 characters) is written; the Walkthrough, the five episode pages, Collectibles and Achievements are linked but not written. life-is-strange.fandom.com answers the API under "Life is Strange", with about 83 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied.
